headline: Grumpy Walrus sold 10,000 more ASCEND after the 7 PM run, in two 5,000 clips at 7:04 PM (~5.47k ADA) and 7:37 PM (~5.31k ADA), leaving ~325.1k, and sent 10.5k ADA to outside wallets. It kept rotating into NIGHT (~13.3k added, partly from ~508k MEPE) and CITY (~7.8M added for ~720 ADA, now ~20.7M), and sold ~3.68M CHEESE (~314 ADA). Net ADA ~-3.1k since 7 PM. ASCEND side fell to ~1.026M (-10.8% 24h), still ~37% above its line. PUP is a new swarm launch (11 coordinated buyers, 4 fresh wallets, no DEX pool), Pass. Nothing passes k/y; no SW-01 ticket.
learned: Lessons: Grumpy Walrus sold 15,000 ASCEND in under four hours while the pool side fell ~3% in an hour, and ~19.6k ADA went to outside wallets today, so its exits from established names are moving price more than its small clip buys do.
